page.layout: One column of running text, centred on the page; running head at the top; page number at the top right; catchword "refe-" at the foot right; a small stroke mark at the foot centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: 935. Genuam Liguriæ urbem Sarra-ceni depopulati sunt: collectaque ingenti præda, in Africam redierunt.
941. Hugo Italiæ rex Fraxineto cap-pto, Sarracenam classem exussit.
944.Radamirus rex Galliciæ, maximum exercitum Sarracenorũ fudit in Hispania.

p.i: Nullus tum Gallicia Rex: sed Ramirus in Asturia regnabat.

main_text.p: 951. Sarraceni Calabriam, Apuliam, Lucaniam cædibus & incendiis replentes, virtute Alberici Hetrusci Marchionis re-pressi sunt, & in agro Minturnensi in Campania ad Lyrim fluvium superati, cum accessionem ad urbem Romam in-stituissent.
952. Sarraceni ex Gargano monte, in quem se contulerant, incursiones frequen-tes in finitimos faciunt. Beneventum ca-ptum incendunt.
969. Otho primus Germanorum Im-perator, Sarracenos Italia expulit, & Gar-ganum montem recepit.
970.SarraceniConsentiam recuperarunt, ex qua paulò ante ab Ungaris ejecti erant.

page.notes: The "Q" at the foot centre is a catchword-like signature mark, and the catchword is "refe-". Some words in the line 952 and 977 are slightly blurred; "Beneventum" and "Candiam" are read with some doubt. The stroke at the foot centre is a page mark, not text.
